verdict.line: You lose if you trade into his Obliterate on cooldown before level 9; you win once Hollow Radiance and Unending Despair come online and the fight moves to open ground.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's Q (Obliterate) deals bonus damage to a single target and his passive (Darkness Rise) grants a damage aura plus move speed after 3 landed hits, so every extended trade snowballs toward him. Ornn has no way to punish that passive proc directly and his own R (Call of the Forge God) is nullified if Mordekaiser pulls him into R (Realm of Death), so this is a lane you survive with Q's slow and W's Brittle, then win later once your resistance items and teamfight knockup outscale his 1v1 sustain.

theirWindow.when: he's landed 2+ hits on you already
theirWindow.what: He is one spell or auto away from Darkness Rise proccing a damage aura and move speed burst. Back off and let the trade end instead of extending it — disengaging now costs less than eating the empowered third hit.

yourWindow.when: W's final gout of flame lands (Brittle applied)
yourWindow.what: Only commit your full trade — Q (Volcanic Rupture) slow into autos — once Brittle is on him from W (Bellows Breath). Trading before Brittle just feeds his single-target Q bonus for free.

start.why: Doran's Helm has the higher measured win rate of the two listed starts (50% over 40 games) and its magic-resist-oriented stats blunt Obliterate's early poke damage better than a flat shield.

boots.why: Mercury's Treads are the clear pick-rate and win-rate leader (51.3% over 80 games) — the tenacity shortens how long Death's Grasp (E, pulls all enemies in an area) locks you down before you can W or walk away.

core.why: Highest-performing core path start (87.5% win rate over 8 games) — the resistance spike is exactly where the matchup flips from them to you.
Stacks more flat resistances on top of Hollow Radiance to blunt the magic burst from Obliterate and the sustained aura damage once Darkness Rise procs.
Closes out the measured core path and gives you the resistance stacking you need to out-sustain his passive in extended skirmishes once lane is over.

situational.when: his Indestructible (W) shield-to-heal is snowballing his sustain in extended trades
he or his jungler are threatening a burst all-in through your R window
you're getting poked below half HP by Obliterate before level 6

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp heals you off autos during the poke war Obliterate forces on you, and it's the higher win-rate page measured (52.4% over this sample) — exactly what you need to survive before your resistance items come online.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the overwhelming pick (79.7% pick rate) because this lane is about surviving to your item spike, not forcing early kills — Teleport lets you reset the wave and skip the losing poke exchanges. Flash+Ignite (59.1% win rate) is a viable alternative if you want to punish his early all-ins before his W shield scales.

playing.title: Trade only after Brittle
playing.detail: Only commit a full trade once W's final gout has applied Brittle. Trading on cooldown just feeds Obliterate's single-target bonus damage.

playing.title: Respect Death's Grasp range
playing.detail: E pulls all enemies in its 700 range and its cooldown drops to 8s by level 16. Don't stand at that range when it's up — you'll get yanked into his passive proc window.

playing.title: Save R for open ground
playing.detail: Your R disappears if you're dragged inside his Realm of Death. Only summon or charge the elemental when he can't ult you — from max range or after his R (cooldown 140 down to 80s) is on cooldown.

playing.title: End fights before his third hit
playing.detail: Darkness Rise procs a damage aura and move speed after he lands 3 hits on you. Disengage before that third hit lands instead of trying to out-damage the empowered version.

playing.title: Shove, don't duel, before 9
playing.detail: Use Q's fissure and pillar to push waves rather than extend trades. You're racing to your Hollow Radiance spike, not trying to win the lane outright before then.

playing.title: Freeze under tower when poked low
playing.detail: After two Obliterates land on you, hug tower and regen off Doran's Helm sustain instead of taking a third single-target hit.

playing.title: Regroup once your core is live
playing.detail: From level 9-13 onward your resistances flip the 1v1 math. Look to leave lane for skirmishes where Brittle plus your R knockup outvalues his passive sustain.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, and summoner numbers are measured OP.GG win rates and pick rates from live games on the current patch (16.20.1); the tactical reasoning — trade timing, R interaction with Realm of Death, passive proc windows — is the author's own read of the ability mechanics, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Mordekaiser’s (P) gives him the upper hand in prolonged fights. Time your [W] well to block (E) and (R). Be careful that your [R] will disappear inside Mordekaiser’s Realm of Death (R), so try to use it from afar.
